# Keel

> The SQLite of durable execution: production-grade resilience (retry, backoff,
> timeout, circuit breaker, rate limit, LLM dev-cache) and opt-in crash-resumable
> durable flows, as an in-process library with zero code changes. Policy lives in
> one `keel.toml`; state is files in `.keel/`. No daemon, no port, no login.

Keel intercepts a program's outbound calls (httpx/requests/fetch, LLM SDKs,
`py:`/`ts:` function targets) and applies a policy at the call boundary. Adding
it is `keel run app.py` / `keel run app.mjs` — no imports, no context objects, no
base classes. Uninstalling the package removes the behavior and nothing else.

Status (v0.6.1, 2026-09-16): Tier 1 and Tier 2 (including async flows) work
end-to-end in both Python and Node on the real Rust core, with `kill -9`
resume, a Postgres journal backend for fleet durability, `keel
record`/`keel sim`, and a scoped Rust front end (`#[keel::wrap]` +
reqwest-middleware). Agent frameworks are first-class: Google ADK Runner
flows and cross-model fallback, zero-launcher activation (`KEEL_ENABLE=1`),
and a CI adapter farm certified against six real frameworks (ADK,
pydantic-ai, openai-agents, crewai, langgraph, MCP) — see "Keel for Google
ADK + agents-cli" below. Since then: a **poll-until-terminal** primitive for
long-running operations (`[target."…".poll]`, KEEL-E016) with **route keys**
(a `[target]` key carrying a method and path, consulted before Keel's own LLM
host map); **`cmd:` durable flows** and `keel exec` for external commands
(KEEL-E033); a console **exit summary** plus `keel report` (static /
`--watch` / `--serve` HTML); and a deployment-honesty pass — strict
`KEEL_CWD`, serverless-aware dev-cache defaults, activation evidence in
`keel status`/`keel doctor`, and Dockerfile `COPY keel.toml` checks.
Wrapped-call overhead ~0.8 µs vs a 10 µs budget. Published: `pip install
keelrun keelrun-cli`, `npm install keelrun keelrun-cli`, `cargo add keelrun
--rename keel` + `cargo install keelrun-cli`, or zero-install via `uvx --from
keelrun-cli keel run app.py`. Every registry is live except one npm platform
package, `keelrun-cli-win32-x64` (blocked by npm's own anti-spam system, not
a code issue; cargo/pip/uvx cover Windows in the meantime). A Claude Code
Skill (`packaging/claude-skill/keel/`, also `npx skills add MisterTK/keel`)
and `keel doctor`'s pre-existing-resilience detection (tenacity/backoff,
hand-rolled retry/poll loops) ship too.

## Start here

- [README](README.md): status, quickstart per language, demo + conformance tables, repo layout.
- [Architecture spec](docs/architecture-spec.md): the two-tier model (Tier 1 resilience, Tier 2 durability), core, journal, front ends.
- [DX spec](docs/dx-spec.md): the "just works" ladder (Levels 0–3), DX invariants, agent-framework packs, the agent-facing surface.

## Concepts (one canonical example each)

- [Level 0 — zero config](docs/dx-spec.md): `keel run app.py` → conservative production defaults on every discovered call. Never changes success-path semantics; never retries non-idempotent calls by default.
- [Level 1 — `keel init`](docs/dx-spec.md): generate a `keel.toml` from static + observed evidence; every entry cites `file:line`. `keel init --diff` previews changes.
- [Level 2 — durable flows](demos/durable-pipeline/README.md): list `py:mod:fn` (Python) or `ts:mod#fn` (Node) under `[flows]`; a crashed run resumes and replays completed steps without re-firing effects, including concurrent async effects inside one flow.
- [Targets](contracts/policy.schema.json): `host` (e.g. `api.stripe.com`), `py:`/`ts:` functions, semantic `llm:<provider>` / `tool:<name>` / `mcp:<server>`, `cmd:<name>` for external commands, and **route keys** — a key carrying a method and path (`POST *-aiplatform.googleapis.com/*:fetchPredictOperation`) that beats the LLM host map for that route.
- [LLM dev-cache](demos/agent-demo/README.md): `cache = { mode = "dev" }` replays identical prompts off `KEEL_ENV=prod`; with the native core it persists across runs (~0 API calls on a repeat). `cache = { mode = "off" }` disables it for a target; the cache is off by default on serverless platforms.
- [Poll until terminal](README.md): `poll = { interval = "10s", deadline = "30m", until = { field = "done", terminal = [true] } }` turns a submit-then-poll long-running operation into one awaited call. Poll wraps retry; cache/rate/breaker see one call; KEEL-E016 on deadline. It applies to any call Keel judges idempotent — including Google `:fetch*Operation` POSTs.
- [Observability](README.md): a one-screen exit summary on every run, `keel report` for a self-contained HTML view (`--watch` / `--serve`), and `KEEL_LOG_FORMAT=json` to emit the startup line, the summary, and errors as one JSON object per line.
- [ADK Runner flows + cross-model fallback](README.md): designate `py:google.adk.runners:Runner.run_async` under `[flows] entrypoints` for durable, crash-resumable agent turns, and set `fallback = [...]` on `llm:google-genai` for real cross-provider fallback via the plugin's `on_model_error` hook — both farm-certified against real `google-adk`.

## Reference

- [Policy schema](contracts/policy.schema.json) and [smart defaults](contracts/defaults.toml).
- [Error codes](contracts/error-codes.json): the frozen `KEEL-E0NN` taxonomy. `keel explain <code>` prints what/why/next.
- [CLI](crates/keel-cli): `run · init · doctor (--effective-policy) · status · report · explain · exec · flows (suggest/add/resume/force) · trace · replay · tail · fsck · mcp · record (run/list/test) · sim`; every command has a deterministic `--json` twin.
- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt): the full corpus (all of the above expanded, with the CLI + error-code reference inline).

## For coding agents

- Run `keel doctor --json` before changing resilience behavior; propose edits as a diff (`keel init --diff`).
- `keel init --agents` drops a Keel section into `AGENTS.md`.
- `keel mcp` serves the CLI as an MCP server over stdio: tools `get_status`, `get_doctor_report`, `propose_policy` (a keel.toml diff), `get_trace`, `list_flows`, `explain_error` — each byte-identical to the matching `--json` command.
- Zero-launcher activation: pip/npm dependency + `KEEL_ENABLE=1` (`.pth` / `NODE_OPTIONS=--import keelrun/register`); `KEEL_CWD` relocates the config root in BOTH languages. `KEEL_CWD` is an assertion — if it names a directory with no `keel.toml`, Keel refuses to activate, says so on one line, and the host runs keel-free (`KEEL_POLICY=optional` restores defaults-with-a-warning).
- Output is deterministic (sorted keys, no timestamps unless asked) so `--json` is diffable.
- Google ADK / `agents-cli` projects: start from `agents-cli scaffold create my-agent -a MisterTK/keel/packaging/agents-cli-template`, or install the coding-agent skill with `npx skills add MisterTK/keel` (`skills/keel/`).
